result.reason: The operative language gives Company a 30-day written-notice right to terminate the Agreement or any SOW for convenience and requires a refund of prepaid fees for unperformed Services, substantively achieving the preferred customer position. Contractor retains a convenience right only when no SOW is outstanding, so it cannot terminate during an active committed engagement. The change is targeted and preserves the breach, payment, and work-product provisions. Drafting is professional, though the margin comment slightly overstates that payment for performed Services is expressly addressed for convenience terminations; the payment sentence in subsection (b) most naturally applies only to breach terminations.
